name: MLS(ASCP) / MLS(ASCPi) certification
body: American Society for Clinical Pathology Board of Certification (ASCP BOC)
format: Per secondary sources: 100 multiple-choice questions, 2 h 30 min, computer adaptive testing. NOT verified against the official guideline in this build.

name: Philippine Medical Technologist Licensure Examination (MTLE)
body: Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) — Professional Regulatory Board of Medical Technology
format: Written examination (R.A. 5527, Sec. 15). Passing as enacted: general average ≥75% with no subject below 50% (Sec. 19) — confirm current PRC rules.

outline.title: R.A. No. 5527 (Philippine Medical Technology Act of 1969), Sec. 17 — Scope of Examination
outline.verificationNote: Read 2026-10-07. Sec. 17 lists subjects and relative weights (below) and allows the Board to change subjects or weights with approval.

outline.title: PRB of Medical Technology Resolution No. 13, s. 2023 — Enhanced Tables of Specifications
outline.verificationNote: Resolution text read 2026-10-07: adopts the enhanced TOS (Annex A) from the August 2023 MTLE onward and supersedes Res. No. 12 s. 2009. Annex A itself (topics, item counts, current weights) was NOT retrieved — prc.gov.ph returned HTTP 403. Topic lists in this app are therefore not TOS-verified.
